They fought alongside us at Vimy Ridge, Juno Beach, and the Imjin River. They came home to a government that stripped their status, stole their land, took their children, and poisoned their water. Nine years after the TRC, Canada has implemented roughly 13 of 94 Calls to Action. This is the ledger.
